verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an expense-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not show it: the only export evidence is automatic syncing of finalized reports to QuickBooks Online and NetSuite, which are proprietary accounting systems, not open formats. The Integration Server API docs cover only how to get credentials and OAuth tokens. Nothing documents a bulk or full-account export in CSV, JSON or similar formats, or a path to take all your data and leave.
